_meta.summary: Fires when any HA automation run produces an ERROR span in the last 5 minutes.
_meta.why_this_filter: HA surfaces a failing step (e.g. good_night's `{{ 1 / 0 }}` template) on the CHILD service-call span (service.name=ha.persistent_notification, statusCode=2), NOT on the ha.automation root - `continue_on_error` keeps the root green. So the honest, demo-able signal is 'any error span across the reconstructed automation trace' (hasError = true). Every span in this SigNoz instance is an ha.* automation span, so hasError=true == 'an automation is failing'.
_meta.fire_on_demand: good_night fires every 2 min and errors on its own; or force it: POST /api/services/script/turn_on {"entity_id":"script.demo_burst"} (see FIRE-ON-DEMAND.md). One eval cycle (<=1m frequency, 5m window) later the rule goes 'firing'.
_meta.op_encoding: op '1' = above; matchType '1' = at least once; target 0 => fire when error-span count > 0 in any 1-min bucket.

annotations.summary: A Home Assistant automation is failing
annotations.description: One or more automation steps raised an error in the last 5 minutes (error-span count > 0). In the seeded demo house this is good_night's deliberate divide-by-zero template error, surfaced as an ERROR span on its persistent_notification.create service call. Open Trace Explorer and filter hasError = true to see the failing run.
